purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of the --quiet startup option (docs/STARTUP_QUIET.md): each scenario of tests/startup_quiet.rs with and without --quiet (print() in .bzl, analysis and repository rule code, a deprecation warning, a successful action writing to stdout/stderr, a failing action, an analysis failure, --keep_going, a passing and a failing test with and without --test_output=errors, run, query, a repository rule download + execute(quiet = False), info). Evidence only; not an input of any test.

reference.startup: SERVER mode (--batch ignores --quiet for events: the client sends it with the request only) --ignore_all_rc_files [--quiet] --output_user_root=<private> --output_base=<private> --host_jvm_args=-Xmx512m --max_idle_secs=60, shutdown after each run
reference.flags: --registry=file://<private copy of tests/fixtures/builtin_modules/registry> --incompatible_autoload_externally= --lockfile_mode=off --noshow_progress --color=no --curses=no --repository_cache=<private> --distdir=<seeded from verified local CAS> (not info)
reference.env: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, private HOME/TMPDIR, umask 022; a local HTTP server for the download

categories: per run, the kinds of console output it shows: debug (DEBUG lines; native: the raw print lines), info (INFO lines; native also `bazel-rs: Running command line`), warning, fail_line, error (native also its `bazel-rs: action|analysis of` failure lines), native_note (other `bazel-rs:` lines, native-only), target_result (`Target //x up-to-date:`; native `LABEL<TAB>PATH`), test_summary, test_log (`Test output for`), successful_action_output, failed_action_output, run_binary_output, repository_execute_echo, query_output, info_output.
comparison: EXACT = equal exit codes (loud = quiet = genuine); of the categories both loud runs show, the quiet runs show the same ones (each kept or dropped by both), and the native quiet run shows no native_note and nothing its loud run does not. Categories only one side shows whatever the verbosity are pre-existing format differences, not compared: target_result (genuine --show_result=1 prints no `Target` lines for 2+ targets, native always prints `LABEL<TAB>PATH`; genuine prints `Target //:broken failed to build`). The native test pins the native quiet stdout/stderr bytes.
